# Psalm 39 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 39:1 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** For-the-choirmaster, for-Jeduthun. A-psalm of-David.
- **LOGOS:** For the choirmaster. For Jeduthun. A psalm of David.
- **PNEUMA:** For Jeduthun, the music director. A psalm of David.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 39:3 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** I-was-mute [with] silence; I-was-silent from-good, and-my-pain was-stirred.
- **LOGOS:** I was mute and silent; I held my peace to no avail, and my distress grew worse.
- **PNEUMA:** But as I stood there in silence — not even speaking of good things — the turmoil within me grew worse.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 39:4 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** My-heart grew-hot within-me; in-my-musing a-fire burned. [Then] I-spoke with-my-tongue:
- **LOGOS:** My heart became hot within me. As I mused, the fire burned; then I spoke with my tongue:
- **PNEUMA:** The more I thought about it, the hotter I got, igniting a fire of words:

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 39:9 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** From-all my-transgressions deliver-me; the-reproach of-the-fool do-not make-me.
- **LOGOS:** Deliver me from all my transgressions. Do not make me the scorn of the fool!
- **PNEUMA:** Rescue me from my rebellion. Do not let fools mock me.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 39:11 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Remove from-me Your-stroke; from-the-hostility of-Your-hand I-am-consumed.
- **LOGOS:** Remove Your stroke from me; I am spent by the hostility of Your hand.
- **PNEUMA:** But please stop striking me! I am exhausted by the blows from Your hand.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 39:6 (overlap: 4%)

- **EMET:** Behold, handbreadths You-have-made my-days, and-my-lifetime [is] as-nothing before-You. Surely all-vanity [is] every-man standing. Selah.
- **LOGOS:** Behold, You have made my days a few handbreadths, and my lifetime is as nothing before You. Surely all mankind stands as a mere breath! Selah.
- **PNEUMA:** You have made my life no longer than the width of my hand. My entire lifetime is just a moment to You; at best, each of us is but a breath.' Pause and reflect.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
